description: Depuratori della Regione Emilia-Romagna - edizione 2019 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by arpae.it. Localization of urban wastewater treatment plants of the Emilia-Romagna Region - update 2018 - 2019 edition. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Purifiers of the Emilia-Romagna Region - 2019 edition" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2018-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
